original_finding_content.subject: Reclame Aqui — out of scope (language)
original_finding_content.raw_text:
fetch of https://www.reclameaqui.com.br/empresa/hotmart/ returned permissions error. Reclame Aqui is a Brazilian consumer complaint platform; content is primarily Portuguese.  
**Notes:** SD-06. Out of scope per language requirement (Spanish only). Site blocked on fetch.
